regions.today: Mainly cloudy, breezy and humid today with a few patches of drizzle. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees with moderate to fresh southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will bring further patches of drizzle and mist but also longer drier spells. Hill and coastal fog too. A mild, humid night with lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees. Moderate westerly winds will freshen again overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Cloudy with patchy drizzle to start on Friday, but this will begin to clear in the morning with brighter spells developing through the day. A chance of mist or fog lingering on southeast coasts into the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees, mildest further to the southeast, all in a fresh westerly wind.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Thursday. Moderate to high on Friday.
